triage.kind_span: This Amendment No. 2 is the final amendment to the Schedule TO and is being filed (i) to report the final results of the Exchange Offer

subject_names.span: filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust, a Delaware statutory trust

security_class.span: relating to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares

price_basis.span: Calculated as the aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer, based upon a price of 96% of the liquidation preference of $25,000 per share (or $24,000 per share).

size_pct_outstanding.span: offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares

size_shares.span: Calculated as the aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer

commencement_date.span: Under the terms of the Offer, which commenced March 17, 2021 and expired April 14, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Exchange Offer expired at 5:00 p.m. New York City time, on April 14, 2021.

shares_tendered.span: 6,105 Auction Rate Preferred Shares were validly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the expiration of the Exchange Offer

shares_accepted.span: all 6,105 Auction Rate Preferred Shares, representing 95.8% of the outstanding Auction Rate Preferred Shares on the Expiration Date, were accepted for exchange

notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 2; the final-amendment box is checked) to the exchange offer for the unlisted Series B, C and E auction rate preferred shares, exchanged for Series J Cumulative Term Preferred Shares plus cash. Conflict between documents: the Rule 13e-4(c)(4) statement in the main document (seq 1) says 6,105 ARPS were tendered and all 6,105 accepted (95.8% of outstanding). The attached press release (seq 2) says tenders came in for 96% of outstanding and 5,817 Series J shares would be issued 'in exchange for the 6,106 Auction Rate Preferred Shares tendered'. The formal seq 1 figure (6,105) is used for both fields; the two sources were not averaged. proration_factor_pct is null: all tendered shares were accepted, but no factor is stated. final_price_per_share is null: consideration was 0.96 of a Series J Preferred Share (liquidation preference $25,000) per ARPS plus cash in lieu of fractional shares, not a dollar price. The $24,000-per-share figure appears only in the fee-calculation footnote. The press release also states $1,119,000 aggregate cash in lieu of fractional shares and Series J issuance on or about April 20, 2021; untendered ARPS remain outstanding unchanged. Proration, conditions and the reason for the offer are not stated in this amendment (null). GDV is the common-share ticker; the ARPS themselves are unlisted.
